exposure: sociodemographic characteristics (age, residence, parity, antenatal booking status)
maternal complications (e.g., pulmonary edema, cerebrovascular accident, HELLP syndrome, acute kidney injury, MODS, aspiration pneumonia, pulmonary embolism)
ICU interventions received (e.g., advance monitoring, mechanical ventilation, vasoactive drugs)
cohort: The study included 65 women diagnosed with postpartum eclampsia who were admitted to the Intensive Care Unit of Mymensingh Medical College Hospital.
finding: The study found a maternal case fatality rate of 7.69% among postpartum eclampsia patients admitted to the ICU, suggesting that intensive care monitoring is effective in controlling maternal mortality.
